projects.title: Migrating Legacy WordPress Store to Next.js Engine
projects.tagline: How speed optimization reduced cart bounce rates and scaled transactions.
projects.challenge: Apex suffered from slow page paints (LCP: 4.8 seconds), causing a 38% cart abandonment rate on mobile traffic and a poor Lighthouse performance score (32/100).
projects.solution: Rebuilt their catalog stack on Next.js App Router on Vercel CDN. Configured static generation for products index and dynamic checkout flows with local Steafast Courier hooks.

projects.title: Meta Pixel Conversions API (CAPI) Integration
projects.tagline: Regaining 30%+ lost pixel signals caused by ad blockers and iOS 14 policies.
projects.challenge: iOS 14 privacy parameters and browser ad blockers blocked up to 35% of client-side purchase pixels, leaving ad campaigns under-attributed and causing high CPA.
projects.solution: Established a secure server-side tracking pipe. Events (Purchase, Lead, ViewContent) are dispatched directly from the Next.js server with unique event_id deduplication keys.
